statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because current U.S. trading is modestly weaker but not persistently one-way ahead of Nvidia.
recommendation: Tail remains below the WATCH threshold. Event Stress rises sharply into Nvidia's results and conference-call sequence after the cash close.
headline: Low Tail risk persists while Nvidia event Stress rises into the close
body: Latest verified reporting showed modest Nasdaq weakness and slightly negative breadth rather than a persistent no-retracement path. Nvidia's results and call create a concentrated after-hours repricing window; higher Tail remains conditional on observed directional efficiency and failed retracements.

lookbackSummary: Published hourly assessments over the prior 24 clock-hours kept Tail in the low band. Stress peaked around the U.S. macro release and cash open, eased afterward, and is rising again into Nvidia's after-hours catalyst window.
outlookSummary: Immediate Tail remains low under modest, non-persistent index weakness. Stress rises sharply into Nvidia's results and call, then should normalize if retracements are meaningful before Thursday's U.S. data and Friday's Jackson Hole keynote.

forecast.analysis: Current U.S. trading remains modestly softer with slightly negative breadth rather than persistent one-way structure. Tail stays low while event Stress rises into Nvidia after the cash close.
drivers: Modest Nasdaq weakness without verified no-retracement structure
Nvidia results and call are the dominant near-term catalyst

news.title: Wall St awaits Nvidia's AI verdict after hot inflation data

forecast.analysis: Into the cash close and expected Nvidia release, Stress becomes extreme. Tail remains below WATCH unless the initial repricing becomes persistently directional with shallow or failed retracements.
The first full post-release hour carries the highest conditional path risk. WATCH applies only if directional extension persists and mean reversion remains weak through semiconductor transmission.
drivers: Depth of the first meaningful retracement

forecast.analysis: The conference-call hour creates a credible second information wave. WATCH remains conditional on sustained follow-through through guidance and Q&A rather than on transient volatility alone.
After the call, continued one-way extension would keep Tail near WATCH. Meaningful retracement, sector dispersion, or stabilization would lower path risk even if volatility remains elevated.
As the earnings shock matures, two-way price discovery would return Tail to the low band. Session-extreme holding with repeated extension would delay normalization.
Early overnight risk should ease if the Nvidia move retraces normally and semiconductor leadership stops reinforcing one direction. Unresolved extension would keep Stress high.
Overnight conditions remain lower risk if repeated extension does not resume and cross-asset signals stay mixed rather than directionally aligned.
With the main earnings catalyst absorbed, normal consolidation would keep Tail low. Fresh one-way semiconductor follow-through would be the principal invalidation.
A stable Asian handoff would keep Tail low if the prior move is being retraced or consolidated rather than extended with increasing directional efficiency.
If overnight volatility continues to decay, Tail should remain low. A renewed sector-wide gap extension would be the main reason to reassess.
Late Asian trade should be comparatively calm if Nvidia-related repricing has become two-way. Persistent index-extreme holding would keep Stress from normalizing fully.
The European open becomes a fresh transmission checkpoint. Tail stays low if futures absorb the handoff with normal pullbacks and no broad cross-asset alignment.
During early Europe, the key condition is whether overnight direction broadens or fades. Mixed breadth and retracements would support low Tail.
Approaching the U.S. premarket, residual Nvidia sensitivity may reappear. Tail remains low unless renewed directional efficiency develops across semiconductors and index futures.
Premarket liquidity and positioning can raise Stress without raising Tail. Meaningful pullbacks would keep the path consistent with normal two-way trade.
Ahead of Thursday's U.S. data window, event sensitivity rises moderately. Tail stays low unless price action is already one-way before the releases.
The hour containing the 12:30 UTC U.S. releases carries higher Stress. Tail remains conditional on the actual post-release path rather than the existence of the data event.
Immediately after the U.S. data, whipsaw risk is elevated. Tail would rise only if the move sustains directional extension with weak retracements into the cash open.
At the cash open, two-way auction behavior would keep Tail below WATCH. A clean opening drive with shallow pullbacks would be the main adverse path signal.
After the opening auction, normalization is favored if retracements are meaningful and breadth is not uniformly aligned with the index move.
Mid-morning conditions should be lower risk if the opening move has become rotational rather than one-way. Persistent sector leadership would keep Stress elevated.
Late morning risk remains modest if price discovery is balanced. A renewed extension after failed retracement would be the key adverse checkpoint.
Around midday, normal consolidation would keep Tail low. Any renewed one-way move would need fresh cross-asset and sector confirmation to justify a higher path-risk state.
